gloss: appetizer; snack to go with drinks

definitions.gloss: appetizer, snack to go with drinks, side dish for drinking
definitions.explanation: Food eaten as an accompaniment to alcoholic drinks. Can range from simple snacks to elaborate dishes served alongside sake or other alcohol.

definitions.gloss: topic of conversation (for amusement), material for gossip
definitions.explanation: Something used as material for conversation or entertainment, especially when drinking. Often used in the expression {話|はなし}の{肴|さかな} (something to talk about over drinks).

examples.japanese: ⟦{酒|さけ}の{肴|さかな}→酒の肴：08726_sakenosakana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{枝豆|えだまめ}→枝豆：21197_edamame⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered edamame as a snack to go with my drink.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肴|さかな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
examples.english: This place has a wide variety of appetizers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肴|さかな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べて→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧、⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{晩酌|ばんしゃく}→晩酌：14923_banshaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I lined up homemade appetizers and enjoyed a leisurely evening drink.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗談|しっぱいだん}→失敗談：09950_shippaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{酒|さけ}の{肴|さかな}→酒の肴：08726_sakenosakana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Use tales of failure as conversation material over drinks.
It's not good to make gossip about others your entertainment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肴|さかな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{旧友|きゅうゆう}→旧友：17475_kyuuyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{飲|の}み{明|あ}かした。
examples.english: Using travel memories as conversation material, we drank with old friends until late into the night.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY NOTE:
Historically, {肴|さかな} was the original meaning of the word さかな — food to accompany sake. The meaning of "fish" (⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧) developed later because fish was the most common accompaniment to sake.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{酒|さけ}の{肴|さかな}→酒の肴：08726_sakenosakana⟧ (appetizer for drinks; conversation material)
- {肴|さかな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (use as drinking snack; use as conversation material)
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肴|さかな} (topic for conversation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦つまみ→つまみ：16139_tsumami⟧: snack to go with drinks (more casual, everyday word)
- ⟦おつまみ→おつまみ：14928_otsumami⟧: snack to go with drinks (polite form of ⟦つまみ→つまみ：16139_tsumami⟧)
- {酒肴|しゅこう}: food to accompany alcohol (literary/formal)
